notes.title: Project Highrise & City of Gangsters are in the Kasedo Publisher Sale!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

Both of our games, Project Highrise & City of Gangsters are taking part in the Kasedo Publisher Sale! 

Running until Friday 24th September, you can get up to 77% off Project Highrise as well as up to 50% off all Project Highrise DLC including:


Las Vegas
Miami Malls
Tokyo Towers
London Life
Brilliant Berlin


Make sure to check out our latest release City of Gangsters too!

Set in 1920s prohibition, our new management tycoon game lets you start up your very own criminal operation. Building speakeasies, managing production chains and smuggling goods throughout the city - it'll be your job to turn this town into a well-oiled money machine! 

Get 25% off both the City of Gangsters base game AND Deluxe Edition. We've also recently updated to Version 1.1, so you can enjoy creating your very own fully customizable maps!

Thanks again for your support and remember to follow us over on Twitter for all the latest on future projects!


Matt & Rob
Co-founders - SomaSim

notes.title: Project Highrise turns 4!
notes.content:
Hey guys!

This time 4 years ago, we released our anticipated PC game Project Highrise to the world!

So we just wanted to take the time to thank each & every one of you for supporting us.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25230864/2f0b2b92b36f22e630acb1b1d7cc4bb487b05714.jpg

Since 2016, we have:

- Welcomed over 250,000 architects
- Received over 2300 recommended reviews
- Released 5 DLCs & expansions (Tokyo Towers, Miami Malls, London Life, Brilliant Berlin & Las Vegas)
- Launched on Nintendo Switch with the feature-complete Architect's Edition
- Added exciting decor & building updates & so much more!

But we're not stopping there. 

To celebrate, we're hosting a number of events throughout the day today!

Join us for: 

- An exclusive Architect Awards video featuring JackSepticEye & many more on Twitter & Facebook
- A merch giveaway on Twitter, Facebook, Discord & Instagram
- A live AMA on Steam's official subreddit (4pm BST / 5pm CET / 10am CDT)
- A Discord  party with us & the whole Somasim team, where we'll stream the game & celebrate (7pm BST / 8pm CET / 6am CDT)

So come join us today for this sky-high celebration across social media & Discord as we reflect, celebrate & welcome in our 5th year!

All the best,

Matt & Rob

Somasim Games

notes.title: Brilliant Berlin now available with Japanese and Traditional Chinese translations
notes.content:
Welcome to Berlin

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25230864/c64f8004a6f4f6997ce82d055a6ecd588af88013.jpg

In Brilliant Berlin, you’ll be challenged to adapt and keep up with the diverse needs of this thriving global city.

The Brilliant Berlin content pack features:


New offices and apartments you’ll create office space to accommodate a wide spectrum of Berlin’s diverse and expanding economy and apartments specially designed for families and children.
New consultant offices that expand the impact of your influence and consultants with new art museums, political offices, union halls and tourist centers.
New restaurants and lobbies New German restaurants coupled with sleek art-deco lobbies and artworks will firmly establish your building’s Berlin bona fides.
... and lots more new features to bolster your newly brilliant Berlin skyscrapers.

In addition, we've added new rooftop decorations that are available to everyone! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/842020/Project_Highrise_Brilliant_Berlin/

こんにちは！
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25230864/98f984a36369833c6d6f916a47bb1f1d67cd4251.jpg

The game is now fully localized into Japanese! We can't wait to see what our new Japanese-speaking players will create as they build skyward!

你好!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25230864/525a2aaf59689495990207240d8040cb20f13e97.png

The game is also now fully translated into Traditional Chinese. Good luck to all of our new players as you create towering skyscrapers!

Full release notes for version 1.5.8 including the new content pack can be viewed here:
https://highrise-static.storage.googleapis.com/release-notes.txt

notes.title: London Life has launched!
notes.content:
Welcome to London

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25230864/f7f1383e5c5f0aefd825e01591d47517e2c4e4b8.png

In London Life, you will be challenged to create gleaming office towers for titans of trade, elite global stock traders and moguls of media. 

The London Life content pack features:

New offices London Life adds 12 new office tenants. Financiers from small banks to sprawling stock exchanges want to be near the global hub of commerce in the City. Creatives of all types from small recording studios and indie game developers, to bustling newsrooms and lofty movie studios, all are attracted by London’s bright lights and pulsing glamour. 
New restaurants Traditional pubs and elegant restaurants impart a bit of English charm to your dining and drinking destinations.
Lux Lobbies and London skyline In addition to a new, brilliantly British background, luxuriant lobbies with chic chandeliers will allow you to create impressive entryways.
Posh artworks Inside and outside, a variety of opulent decorations and posh new artworks, will make your new London premises radiate refinement and prestige.
...and lots more new features to create lofty London Life skyscrapers.


http://store.steampowered.com/app/636502/Project_Highrise_London_Life/

Not ready to head to London just yet? The following changes are now available for everyone:

Security doors that prevent people's passage to help control your tower's traffic
Revolving doors that slow the spread of smells throughout your skyscrapers
Sound doors that negate noise spread in your buildings


Full release notes for version 1.5.11 including the new content pack can be viewed here:
https://highrise-static.storage.googleapis.com/release-notes.txt

notes.title: Tokyo Towers Content Pack Now Available!
notes.content:
Welcome to Tokyo

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25230864/47723a9fc0d5d7d747edce0e85ed67305e75973a.png

In the Tokyo Towers content pack, you’ll build residential towers full of apartments that cater to those seeking an urban oasis of calm amid the carefully choreographed chaos of Japan’s capital.

The Tokyo Towers content pack features:

New apartments. Master the complicated, crowded (and expensive) world of Tokyo’s residential market with new types of apartments.
Food Stalls. Create a vibrant food court full of new stalls that tempt customers at all times of day and night.
Tokyo Exteriors. Design a quintessentially Tokyo residential block complete with matching exteriors and cityscapes inspired by Japan’s unique urban landscape.
New artworks. Bring prestige and beauty to your towers with Japanese-inspired paintings, sculptures and other fine artowrks.
...and lots more new features to create tremendous Tokyo Towers.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/636501/Project_Highrise_Tokyo_Towers/
Not ready to head to Tokyo? The following changes are being rolled out to everyone:

Penthouses and rooftop restaurants updated. You'll be able to choose which direction the outdoor space faces to perfectly suit your tower.
We've retuned the residential services a bit to improve balance.
The decos ribbon has been redone. Items have been removed from DLC-based tabs and placed into their proper category.

Full release notes for version 1.5.8 including the new content pack can be viewed here:
https://highrise-static.storage.googleapis.com/release-notes.txt

notes.title: Miami Malls Content Pack Released!
notes.content:
Welcome to Miami
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25230864/7ca2050a4318bc9d03476ca9e130e9740867dc7d.jpg

In the Miami Malls content pack you’ll strive to establish a mall that rivals some of the world’s great shopping centers. 

The Miami Malls content pack features:

15 additional stores and restaurants! Now you’ll be able to create shopping centers that no longer need offices, apartments or hotels to draw in visitors.
Bus terminals and train stations that will bring even larger crowds to fill your malls and shopping centers.
An observation deck to draw in droves of tourists who might just stop by a food court or a souvenir shop while they’re heading up to take in the panoramic city views.
Towering mall fountains, decorations and wallpapers with tropical flair to match the new Miami Malls stores and restaurants.
...and even more features to help you build a magnificent Miami Mall!


http://store.steampowered.com/app/636500/Project_Highrise_Miami_Malls/
Even if you're not ready to head to Miami, we've got some additions and changes that are available to everyone!


Add your own bit of Miami flavor to your skyscrapers with six new summertime decos in the "Seasonal" tab of the decos menu.
We've redone the logic for visitor generation for retail stores and for some restaurants. You should see a better balance of visitors in all of those.

Full release notes for version 1.5.5 including the new content pack can be viewed here:
https://highrise-static.storage.googleapis.com/release-notes.txt

notes.title: Update 1.5.4 now available - and an announcement!
notes.content:
1.5.4 is now available! The big addition for 1.5.4 is are the "Fast Track" actions. These can be found in the consultants menu and allow you to spend influence to get one-time boosts. And they can be repeated - if you have enough influence!

We're also announcing a new content pack - Miami Malls - which will be available on July 13. Check out the store page for more details!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/636500/Project_Highrise_Miami_Malls/

New Additions:

New "Fast Track" actions in the Consultants dialog. You can spend influence to get one-time boosts, and repeat them as many times as desired (but their price goes up over time). Each fast track action unlocks only after unlocking the entire category of upgrades.
New one-time event for tourist/entertainment events to match the business event
New keyboard shortcuts

Infrastructure: Z (bulldoze), X (build floor), C (build standard elevator)
TAB (press repeatedly to pan camera to top floor, ground floor, and return)
Shift-Q / Shift-E (zoom all the way in or out)
R (show ADA reports)


Changes:

Steam build: visual updates to the main menu, bottom info bar
Updates to French, German, Italian, Russian and Spanish translations

Bug fixes:

Fixed a bug with hotel, casino and event related one-time events occurring without the appropriate things being built



Complete history of release notes:
https://highrise-static.storage.googleapis.com/release-notes.txt

notes.title: 1.5.1 "Golden Nugget" is live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone -

We just released an update that covers some bugs and requested improvements post-Las Vegas expansion.

The big addition is the ability to capture full building images of your tower when you save the game for upload to imgur. Now you can do this:

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25230864/359c2c21268423e9839e2d2a310d6ef8a6c6e254.jpg

Improvements:

Screenshot upload (when saving the game) will now capture an image of the entire building
When using Shift + Left Click to fill an entire floor with a utility wire or pipe, 
  it will no longer get interrupted by existing disconnected wires or pipes.

Bug fixes:

Disable HVAC vent placement if the compressor hasn't been placed yet
Consultant offices can now be relocated as well
Fixed grand casino placement getting locked out when more than 1 marquee was present
Fixed contract Epicurean Empire not counting the Small China Shop
Fixed a couple of missing hotel assets, and some mis-spelled or confusing text
Fixed casinos losing too many visitors during a negative random events
Fixed "Meet ADA/360" achievement not triggering


Full history of release notes is here:
https://highrise-static.storage.googleapis.com/release-notes.txt

notes.title: Welcome to Las Vegas - Expansion Pack is Released!
notes.content:
Welcome to the ostentatious but brilliant Las Vegas.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25230864/4a26f6c1cb60e7286e3a23cd3ccf92e8297a982a.gif
You need to push your management skills to the limit as you try and build the city's next big resort. Transform the once desolate desert of Las Vegas into a swanky hotel, vast casinos and millions of tourists dreaming of making it big. 

The cutthroat world of Sin City features:

Casinos – Entice people to come and part with their hard-earned money in style, with all new casinos.
Hotels – Why do your visitors need to leave at all? Keep the business travellers and high-rollers rolling through, with rooms of all sizes that fit every need - but be sure to keep them happy as your ratings depend on it!
Events & Shows – Bring in the best show in town, and attract crowds of happy visitors... and their wallets. Have them come in for the show, but stay for the food and the games.
VIPs – Invite rock stars, comedians, or business gurus to come and perform at your venue – but just don’t expect them to come for free! The bigger the celebrity, the bigger the demands.  
Evolved Gameplay – Experience how the new location challenges your building skills, from new type of Air Conditioning utility, to special service elevators, NPCs, random events and more.


http://store.steampowered.com/app/582540/

if you’re not ready to “double down” on the Las Vegas expansion, quite a bit of new content has been added to the base game in version 1.5. Here are some highlights:

Mover’s office – Move things around your tower once you’ve built a mover’s office to coordinate and manage the process. 
New tenants – New retail and restaurant tenants are now available. 
New contracts – Take on new contracts from the city to earn extra resources to help build even more prestigious towers!


Full release notes for version 1.5 including the new DLC content can be viewed here:
https://highrise-static.storage.googleapis.com/release-notes.txt

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - Building Amenities is live!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25230864/432f0e882d282002dd6dfaf9d467d390158046d5.jpg
Here are the details of the 1.1.0 content update.

Vending machines are small additions that will help make your residents happy. It gives them a place to take a quick break and escape from their desks for a few minutes. If there is a vending machine on the same floor, chances are that at break time, you’ll see some office workers head over to grab a snack.
Pay phones provide a place for office and apartment dwellers to converse privately in public. Look for them to head there when they need a break to phone home or to make a call away from prying eyes. Since privacy requires some soundproofing, these will also cut the spread of noises a bit as well. Like vending machines, residents will only go to pay phones located on the floor where they live or work.
Shoe shine stations help residents keep their fancy footwear in top form. They’ll visit them during break-time or free time if they are located on the same floor as their office or apartment.
Common areas are relaxing oases from the rigors of urban life. Residents will seek them out during off hours for a few calm moments. They also slightly reduce the spread of noises and smells.
Custodial supply rooms and broom closets help reduce wear and tear and cut down grime. As your building grows, you’ll be able to unlock a supply room that will allow you to place up to three broom closets. If a broom closet is built, grime will accumulate much more slowly for tenants on the same floor as the broom closet. Gaining more prestige will grant you access to more supply rooms and allow placement of more broom closets. Since you are only able to build a few of these, make sure that you place them on high-traffic floors or areas that quickly accumulate grime!


Full release notes can be accessed here: 
http://highrise-static.storage.googleapis.com/release-notes.txt

- Fixed art gallery consultants incorrectly demanding utilities
- Fixed a bug where construction grid was displayed mis-aligned after a height upgrade
- Fixed loan repayment so it will show up in reports as a one-time expense not a daily one
- Fixed a bug where a mis-timed renovation could bring the player's cash amount below $0
- Fixed the renovation button to very clearly gray out if a renovation was already scheduled

notes.title: Update 1.0.4 is live
notes.content:
Enhancements and bug fixes abound:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25230864/a013e68fca1316c74ebe0883f410639a59e946f5.png

We've been following your feedback on the forums, and have another set of fixes and enhancements ready! 

Improvements
- Enabled Steam Cloud syncing
- Added UI scaling below 100% (for displays smaller than 720p)
- Retuned higher-level tenants to make fewer service calls
- Initial construction office can now be removed, and placed elsewhere
  (it shows up in the infrastructure build menu after bulldozing)

Bug fixes
- Fixed a bug with courier and copy center services not reporting correctly
- Fixed UI scaling selection not getting saved
- Fixed incorrect logging of "I can't get to where I need to go" feedback
- Fixed a bug with some gourmet restaurants not being counted in goals
- Fixed a bug with cleaner service causing navigation problems for workers
- Fixed incorrect rent pricing for studio apartments
- Fixed some incorrect animations for restaurant visitors
- Fixed the "+1 construction worker" upgrade getting undone if the player
  bulldozed and rebuilt the expanded construction office
- Services will no longer consider themselves "overloaded" if only a small 
  number of service calls (<= 3) were not fulfilled
- Fixed achievements that were failing to register: the tutorials-related achievement,
  and on Steam, two mods-related achievements
- Wording improvement: clarified placement requirements based on media campaigns
- Fixed inconsistency with "Exclusive Electricity" media campaign,
  now power/water meters get discounted in addition to conduits and closets
- Fixed sports bar not getting counted as a large dinner restaurant in contracts
- Fixed some prestige inconsistencies 

You can find full release notes here: 
http://highrise-static.storage.googleapis.com/release-notes.txt 

And if you haven't yet, we'd really appreciate your review on the game's page! :)

notes.title: Now Available for Pre-Purchase | Workshop Confirmed | Release Date Confirmed
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25230864/02802968f5c2863ec9cf0e74c5c7d978d75e7fe7.gif

For a limited time only, get in on the ground floor and pre-order Project Highrise to access the game on day of release, as well as seven exclusive in-game decorative items to spruce up your burgeoning skyscrapers.

1.	Aurora, a statue inspired by the dawn of modernism.
2.	A bold standing light to adorn and illuminate.
3.	Catalonia chair. A stylish standby of skyscraper lobbies.
4.	A cubist fountain with water gently cascading over carved granite.
